fix_commit_msg:
compressed_decoder.sv: fix c.sh (issue #3051) (#3059)

bit 6 of c.sh must be equal to 0.
If bit 6 equals 1, an illegal instruction exception shall be raised.

---------

Signed-off-by: André Sintzoff <andre.sintzoff@thalesgroup.com>
Co-authored-by: Ayoub Jalali <ayoub.jalali@external.thalesgroup.com>
Co-authored-by: JeanRochCoulon <jean-roch.coulon@thalesgroup.com>
